== Summary ==
Slip “•Courage Of A Skywalker” cut unchanged from page 8 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 1603, 581, 1887)). Version [[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
